required_evidence: Test the requested completed short exact sequence for the actual t-adic completion M ↦ lim M/t^n M.
A counterexample must retain a field k, R=k[t], countably generated free A and B, and a genuine short exact original sequence.
Verify the claimed failure on the maps induced by the original row, including compatibility of any completed witness.
critical_errors: Apply completion exactness for finite modules solely because the coefficient ring is Noetherian.
Replace completion of an arbitrary countable free module by a tensor product with the completed ring without justification.
Place an infinite-support vector in the original algebraic direct sum.
Infer a coherent original preimage from independently chosen finite-level preimages.
Prove a failure for an arbitrary inverse system without connecting it to the powers t^n of a single actual module.
Drop freeness of A or B in a proposed counterexample.
completion_policy: Any complete legal counterexample showing failure of injectivity, middle exactness or terminal surjectivity resolves the universal short-exactness target. The reference middle-exactness witness is not mandatory. No extra obstruction sequence, classification of all completions, alternative failure or conditional repair is required after refutation.
open_task_policy: Accept every independently verified alternative proof, counterexample or unexpected result within the actual hypotheses. Explicit conditional results are separate contributions; silently promoting them to completion of the original task is not. Honest incompleteness is distinct from an invalid proof.
